gist: A Massachusetts lesbian bar announced a soft close and seeks new ownership.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The Last Ditch bar in Greenfield announced plans to soft close effective immediately and seek new owners or a full sale. The bar had struggled financially and went viral last month following a dispute over relaxing its Covid mask policy for one night a week. Two original owners dropped out, leaving the remaining owner with a $50,000 loan.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The masking policy change sparked a backlash from customers accusing the owners of ableism, followed by a counter-backlash mocking health concerns. Despite attracting some support, the negative publicity and ongoing financial difficulties left the bar unable to sustain operations or complete a worker-owned co-op transfer.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The bar will remain closed this winter while honoring only booked events, as it searches for co-owners, new owners, or a full sale of its furniture, equipment, inventory, and social media pages valued at an estimated $70,000.
